separateVerticalMark.visualEvidence: In עמנו immediately after צבאות, a distinct short vertical stroke stands to the left of the qamatz beneath mem. It is separate from the qamatz horizontal and descending stem. The mem has a dagesh; ayin has hiriq; final vav has shuruq.
